newsitem.title: USA: SCAC near deal on Solplax market rights.
newsitem.headline: SCAC near deal on Solplax market rights.

text.p: SCAC Holdings Corp said Thursday it completed primary negotiations to bring its environmentally friendly plastic to Middle East markets.

The company, which recently acquired all patent rights to the so-called Solplax process, said it has an agreement in principal with a Middle East consortium that will pay between $75 million and $100 million to make and market Solplax.
Solplax is an alcohol-based biodegradable plastic that can be used to create non-toxic products for consumer, medical, industrial and hygiene applications, SCAC said.
SCAC shares were trading up 1/2 Thursday at 15-1/2.
